description: TW · Agriculture and Food Production · bioarch.com.tw BIOARCH is a Taiwanese bio-architecture company based in Taipei, specializing in eco-friendly building materials, natural coatings and green construction technologies. Founded around 2010, it operates at the intersection of biotechnology, architecture and sustainability. Its product range includes non-toxic bio-paints, antimicrobial coatings, natural insulation and decorative finish
